outcome: Prevalence of dual burden (SMM and preterm birth)
cohort: All California live births from 2007-2012 with gestations 20-44 weeks (n = 3,059,156)
finding: Multiple factors, including cesarean birth, multiple gestation, hypertensive disorders, and certain demographic and health factors, were associated with a significantly increased risk of experiencing the dual burden of SMM and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth, particularly multiparous primary cesarean, was associated with a threefold to eightfold increased risk of experiencing both SMM and preterm birth.
